name: How accurate are initial remodeling estimates?

mainEntity.name: How accurate are initial remodeling estimates?

acceptedAnswer.text: Initial remodeling estimates provide a general idea of project costs based on preliminary discussions. Their accuracy depends on the level of detail provided by the homeowner and the contractor's ability to foresee potential challenges. More detailed estimates, especially those based on architectural plans, will be more accurate. For large projects, the initial estimate can serve as a baseline, with final costs refined as the project progresses and selections are finalized.
acceptedAnswer.description: Initial estimates offer a general cost idea; accuracy improves with project detail. More precise estimates result from detailed plans and homeowner input, with final costs refined during the project.
